stories.title: New office building and pilot health clinic approved at Hawarden Airport
stories.summary: A new two-storey office building, including a health clinic for pilots, has been approved at Aviation Park, Hawarden Airport. Flintshire County Council approved the application by Aviation Park Group Ltd on 17 September 2026, under delegated powers rather than a full committee vote. stories.title: No trains between Wrexham and Bidston after vehicle hits bridge
stories.summary: Rail services have been cancelled in both directions between Wrexham General and Bidston after a road vehicle collided with a railway bridge in Buckley. stories.title: Buckley’s Brunswick Road pedestrian zone ends under new experimental traffic order
stories.summary: Traffic will return to Brunswick Road in Buckley from 21 September, when Flintshire County Council lifts a ban on driving there that has been in place for the past 26 years.
